context: M7 o5. Midtown Central front desk. Sgt. Kearney behind the blotter.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Arce. Front desk is for complaints, son. Yours I've heard. Next.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Mayhew sells his own furniture and calls it moving. He's at the Rail.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Took a turkey every Christmas for twenty years. Never a dollar. Write that.

lines.speaker: char.pat_kearney
lines.text: Whatever he's selling you, son, check the bottom of the box.
